{{short description|French physicist (born 1934)}}
'''Marie-Anne Bouchiat''' ({{née|Guiochon}}; born 1934){{r|cv}} is a French [[experimental physics|experimental]] [[Atomic physics|atomic physicist]] whose research has included studies of [[neutral current]]s, [[parity violation]], and [[Hyperpolarization (physics)|hyperpolarization]]. She is an honorary [[Academic ranks in France|director of research]] for the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] (CNRS).{{r|acad}}

==Education and career==
Bouchiat was a student at the [[École normale supérieure de jeunes filles]] from 1953 to 1957, and a visiting researcher at [[Princeton University]] from 1957 to 1959. She completed a doctorate in 1964;{{r|cv}} her dissertation was ''Étude par pompage optique de la relaxation d'atomes de rubidium''.{{r|diss}} She worked as a researcher for CNRS from 1972, associated with the [[Kastler–Brossel Laboratory]], until her retirement in 2005.{{r|cv}}

==Personal life==
Bouchiat married physicist [[Claude Bouchiat]]. Their daughter [[Hélène Bouchiat]] is a physicist.<ref>{{url|https://1953.polytechnique.org/Itineraires/Bouchiat.html}}</ref> They have a son, [[Vincent  Bouchiat]] who is a physicist.<ref>{{cite thesis |type=PhD |last=Bouchiat |first=Vincent |date=1997 |title=Quantum fluctuations of the charge in single electron and single Cooper pair devices |publisher=[[Université Pierre et Marie Curie]]  |oclc=1040947759 |url=https://theses.fr/1997PA066241 |quote=Enfin, j'ai une pensée toute particulière pour mes parents, Geneviève, Hélène, et Behnaz pour leur soutien constant durant toutes ces années.}}</ref>

==Recognition==
Bouchiat was elected as a corresponding member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] in 1986, and a full member in 1988.{{r|acad}} She became a member of [[Academia Europaea]] in 1993.{{r|ae}}

She won the [[CNRS gold medal|CNRS bronze and silver medals]] in 1966 and 1971 respectively. The French Academy of Sciences gave her their Hughes Prize in 1968, and the [[Ampère Prize]] in 1983.{{r|cv}}

She is a knight in the [[Ordre des Palmes académiques]], a commander in the [[Ordre national du Mérite]], and a commander in the [[Legion of Honour]].{{r|cv}}
